entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Suriname.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Surinam.
entry.quote: To enter Suriname, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: All travellers to and from Suriname must complete an Immigration and Customs Form up to three days before arrival and departure.
entry.es: Todos los viajeros hacia y desde Surinam deben completar un Formulario de Inmigración y Aduana hasta tres días antes de la llegada y la salida.
entry.quote: All travellers to and from Suriname are required to complete an Immigration and Customs Form [ICF] up to three days before arrival and departure.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: If you bring currency, bring US dollars or euros, as British pounds cannot be exchanged.
entry.es: Si llevas divisas, trae dólares estadounidenses o euros, ya que no se pueden cambiar libras esterlinas.
entry.quote: If you’re bringing currency with you, bring US dollars or euros. You cannot exchange British pounds.

entry.en: Visas and tourist cards are not available at the land (river) border.
entry.es: Los visados y tarjetas de turista no se emiten en la frontera terrestre (fluvial).
entry.quote: Visas/tourist cards are not available at the border.

entry.en: The usual entry stamp allows only 30 days even though the tourist card is valid for 90, and overstaying can lead to a one-year ban.
entry.es: El sello de entrada habitual permite solo 30 días aunque la tarjeta de turista valga 90, y exceder la estadía puede conllevar una prohibición de un año.
entry.quote: Even though the tourist card is valid for 90 days, the usual entry stamp only allows for 30 days which may be extended when in Suriname. Overstaying can lead to a one-year ban

safety.en: There have been incidents of burglary, armed robbery and violent crime in Paramaribo and surrounding areas.
safety.es: Ha habido casos de robo con allanamiento, robo a mano armada y delitos violentos en Paramaribo y alrededores.
safety.quote: There have been incidents of burglary, armed robbery and violent crime in the capital, Paramaribo, and surrounding areas.

safety.en: Criminals could target you in quiet or secluded areas, including the Palm Garden in Paramaribo.
safety.es: Los delincuentes podrían atacarte en zonas tranquilas o aisladas, incluido el Jardín de las Palmas en Paramaribo.
safety.quote: Criminals could target you in quiet or secluded areas, including in the Palm Garden (‘Palmentuin’) and other parts of Paramaribo.

safety.en: Pickpocketing and robbery are increasingly common in the major business and shopping areas.
safety.es: Los carteristas y robos son cada vez más comunes en las principales zonas comerciales.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing and robbery are increasingly common in the major business and shopping areas.

safety.en: Tourists have been robbed in central Suriname, so use a well-established tour company to travel there.
safety.es: Se ha robado a turistas en el centro de Surinam, por lo que se recomienda usar una empresa turística consolidada.
safety.quote: Tourists have been robbed when travelling in central Suriname, away from the coastal areas. Use a well-established tour company if you intend to travel to these parts of the country.

safety.en: Only use licensed taxis or those on official hotel taxi ranks, and do not hail taxis from the roadside.
safety.es: Usa solo taxis con licencia o de las paradas oficiales de hoteles, y no pares taxis en la calle.
safety.quote: Only use licensed taxis or those on official hotel taxi ranks. Do not hail taxis from the roadside.

safety.en: Suriname is prone to flooding, particularly in the north and centre, during the rainy season from May to August.
safety.es: Surinam es propenso a inundaciones, sobre todo en el norte y el centro, durante la temporada de lluvias de mayo a agosto.
safety.quote: Suriname is prone to flooding, particularly in the north and centre of the country, during the rainy season in May to August.

health.en: Medical facilities are severely limited in Suriname, so adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds are needed.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son muy limitados en Surinam, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos disponibles.
health.quote: Medical facilities are severely limited in Suriname. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Not all medical facilities accept insurance payments, so you may need to pay in advance and claim back.
health.es: No todos los centros médicos aceptan pagos de aseguradoras, por lo que quizá debas pagar por adelantado y reclamar después.
health.quote: Not all medical facilities accept payment from insurance companies. You may need to pay in advance and claim the cost back from your travel insurance.

health.en: Health risks include yellow fever, Zika virus, dengue and schistosomiasis.
health.es: Los riesgos de salud incluyen fiebre amarilla, virus del Zika, dengue y esquistosomiasis.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face in Suriname, including:

health.en: Tap water is drinkable in Paramaribo but not elsewhere.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable en Paramaribo pero no en otros lugares.
health.quote: Tap water is drinkable in Paramaribo but not elsewhere.

health.en: Yellow fever, tetanus-diphtheria and hepatitis A vaccinations are recommended.
health.es: Se recomiendan las vacunas contra fiebre amarilla, tétanos-difteria y hepatitis A.
health.quote: Yellow fever vaccination is recommended (and is required to get into Brazil afterwards!) Tetanus-diphtheria vaccination is recommended. Hepatitis A vaccination is recommended.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 115.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 115.

help.en: Alternatively, call 113 for an ambulance or 110 for the fire service.
help.es: Alternativamente, llama al 113 para ambulancia o al 110 para bomberos.

getting_in.en: Tourist card holders can stay up to 90 days; the card is issued on arrival at Schiphol for €35 or at Johan Adolf Pengel airport in cash for US$40.
getting_in.es: Los titulares de tarjeta de turista pueden quedarse hasta 90 días; se emite en Schiphol por 35 € o en el aeropuerto Johan Adolf Pengel en efectivo por 40 USD.
getting_in.quote: are granted a visa on arrival (tourist card) at Amsterdam Airport Schiphol for €35, or at Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport (cash payments in EUR or USD only) or any Surinamese representation abroad for US$40.

getting_in.en: The Suriname consulate in Cayenne offers tourist cards, open Monday to Friday 09:00-14:00.
getting_in.es: El consulado de Surinam en Cayena ofrece tarjetas de turista, abierto de lunes a viernes de 09:00 a 14:00.
getting_in.quote: The Suriname Consulate in Cayenne, French Guiana now offers tourist cards for €31 which can be obtained in an hour.

getting_in.en: The embassy in Georgetown, Guyana also offers the tourist card for US$35.
getting_in.es: La embajada en Georgetown, Guyana, también ofrece la tarjeta de turista por 35 USD.
getting_in.quote: The Embassy of Suriname in Georgetown, Guyana offers the tourist card also, but tend to make you come back in the afternoon to pick it up. Price is US$35.

getting_in.en: Suriname embassies and consulates are often closed without notice, and there is no website to check ahead.
getting_in.es: Las embajadas y consulados de Surinam suelen estar cerrados sin aviso y no hay sitio web para consultar.
getting_in.quote: The Suriname embassies/consulate are often closed without prior/much notice, and there is no website to check ahead of schedule.

getting_around.en: Minibuses and taxis are the most commonly used transport for short and long distances.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses y taxis son el transporte más usado para distancias cortas y largas.
getting_around.quote: in Suriname, minibuses and taxis are the most commonly used forms of transportation for both short and long distances.

getting_around.en: Long-distance bus companies include JAP, Greenheart Group and Pegasus Suriname, linking Paramaribo with other towns and neighbouring countries.
getting_around.es: Las empresas de autobuses de larga distancia incluyen JAP, Greenheart Group y Pegasus Suriname, que conectan Paramaribo con otras ciudades y países vecinos.
getting_around.quote: These companies mainly operate on routes connecting the capital city of Paramaribo with other towns and cities in the country, as well as to neighboring countries such as Guyana and French Guiana.

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left side of the road.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por el lado izquierdo de la carretera.
getting_around.quote: Suriname traffic drives on the left side of the road.

getting_around.en: On dirt roads always rent a four-wheel drive vehicle.
getting_around.es: En caminos de tierra conviene alquilar siempre un vehículo 4x4.
getting_around.quote: on dirt roads, always rent a four-wheel drive vehicle.

getting_around.en: Uber does not operate in Suriname; the only ride-hailing app is Ride Technologies.
getting_around.es: Uber no opera en Surinam; la única aplicación de transporte es Ride Technologies.
getting_around.quote: Uber does not operate in Suriname. The only operating ride hailing app in the country is Ride Technologies.

getting_around.en: Two local airlines, Bluewing Airlines and Gum Air, connect with the interior.
getting_around.es: Dos aerolíneas locales, Bluewing Airlines y Gum Air, conectan con el interior.
getting_around.quote: There are two local airlines providing private connections with the innerland: Bluewing Airlines and Gum Air.

money.en: The local currency is the Suriname dollar (SRD), which is nearly impossible to get rid of outside Suriname.
money.es: La moneda local es el dólar surinamés (SRD), casi imposible de cambiar fuera de Surinam.
money.quote: The local currency is the Suriname dollar, denoted by the symbol "$". The notation SRD (which is also the ISO 4217 international currency code) is commonly used to distinguish it from the US dollar.

money.en: ATMs are available in Paramaribo and most larger northern municipalities; RBTT ATMs accept most international cards.
money.es: Hay cajeros en Paramaribo y en la mayoría de los municipios grandes del norte; los de RBTT aceptan casi todas las tarjetas internacionales.
money.quote: Automatic teller machines (ATM) are available in Paramaribo and in the most larger municipalities in the north. The ATMs of the RBTT bank accept most international bank cards.

money.en: Paying by credit card is highly uncommon, and an extra charge of 2-6% is expected.
money.es: Pagar con tarjeta de crédito es muy poco común y se espera un recargo del 2 al 6 %.
money.quote: Paying by credit card in shops, hotels and restaurants is highly uncommon. Expect 2-6% extra charge.

money.en: Prices of tours, hotels and fancier restaurants are mostly in euros or dollars, so bringing euro or US dollar cash can be convenient.
money.es: Los precios de tours, hoteles y restaurantes elegantes suelen estar en euros o dólares, por lo que puede convenir llevar efectivo en esas divisas.
money.quote: Prices of tours, hotels and fancier restaurants are mostly in euros or dollars, which are then converted into SRD according to the current exchange rate.

money.en: Banks and post offices are open Monday to Friday 07:30-14:00.
money.es: Los bancos y oficinas de correos abren de lunes a viernes de 07:30 a 14:00.
money.quote: Banks and post offices are opened M-F 07:30-14:00.

etiquette.en: Be respectful when taking photographs, as inland people consider certain trees and spots holy and consent is likely needed.
etiquette.es: Sé respetuoso al tomar fotografías, ya que los pueblos del interior consideran sagrados ciertos árboles y lugares y probablemente se necesite consentimiento.
etiquette.quote: the inland-people consider certain trees and spots holy and it is likely you need consent before taking a photograph.
